plot: On a bright morning in the park Dog dares Max to reach Grandma's picnic before her second bell without touching the grass; riding the ball, being carried by Bird and one giant leap all fail, until Max notices a path of blue boxes and finds out Dog, the one who gave the dare, secretly carried them there all morning so his friend could win.

script.title: Dog's Dare: Cross the Park Without Touching Grass

beats.say: Max! I dare you! Cross the park without touching the grass!
No grass at all? Not one paw? Okay... dare accepted!
It is a bright morning. Grandma's picnic is far across the park.
Lunch starts when I ring my bell twice. Don't be late!
Hear that, Max? Get there before the bell. Grass is a no-no!
I'll be the judge! One paw on grass, and you start over!
Then Dog trots away with a blue box in his mouth. Hmm.
Where is Dog going with a box? Never mind. Time to win!
Plan one! I will ride Dog's red ball, like a circus cat!
Max climbs on the ball. It rolls... and rolls... and ROLLS!
Whoa, whoa, WHOA! Stop, ball! Please stop!
Look! The fastest circus cat in the whole park!
Plop! Max tumbles off, right onto the soft green grass.
Grass! That counts! Back to the bench, Max!
The grass is everywhere! How do I get over all of it?
Silly ball. Okay, Mouse. Plan number two!
Far away, Dog trots past again. Thump! Something lands in the grass.
Plan two is me! I can carry you, Max. I'm super strong!
Really, Bird? You are smaller than my tail.
Hold my feet! One, two, three... FLAP!
Bird flaps and flaps. Max goes up one tiny inch.
Puff... puff... Max, how many fish did you eat for breakfast?
Only five. Okay, six. Maybe I eat less fish tomorrow.
Max's paws touch the grass again. Mouse shakes her head.
Hurry, Max! When the bell rings twice, lunch starts without you!
Plan two and a half! I will tiptoe on the flowers!
No, Max! Flowers are for smelling, not for stepping on!
You're right. Sorry, flowers. I will find another way.
Far away, Dog gives a happy little wag. Thump!
Behind the trees, Dog is busy again. Thump! Thump!
Plan three. One super long jump, all the way. Watch this!
Max runs. Max leaps. Max flies through the air...
...and lands in the middle of the park. On the grass.
What a great jump! A great jump right onto grass.
Ooh, so close! Only... the whole park to go.
Three plans, and still grass on my paws. This dare is impossible!
Maybe this dare is too hard, even for a clever cat.
Don't give up, Max! Look around you! Look really close!
That is bell number one! One more, and lunch begins!
Grandma lifts her bell up high. Max has to hurry!
One ring left, Max! You have to get there right now!
Max looks down. Right next to his paw is a blue box.
A box? And there's another one! And another one!
Boxes all the way to the picnic! But who put them here?
Not me! My feet are too tiny to carry boxes.
Not me! I'm the judge. Judges don't carry boxes.
Me! I carried them all morning. I wanted you to win!
But Dog, it was your dare! Didn't you want me to lose?
No way! Dares are only fun when friends can win!
Every time you fell, I put down one more box.
Dog... you were helping me the whole time?
Max hops onto the first box. Then the next. Hop, hop!
Box... box... box! Not one paw on the grass!
Go, Max, go! Hop like a frog!
From the last box, Max takes one giant leap...
...and lands on the picnic blanket just as the bell rings! DING!
Not one paw on the grass! Max wins the dare!
And I win too, because now we share the picnic!
The best dares are the ones where friends help each other.
Tomorrow, I dare Dog to catch a bubble without popping it!

long.title: Dog's Dare: Cross the Park Without Touching Grass! 🐾😂
